problems: east-india-company (1600-1858) overlaps Cliopatria's 'British Empire' row (slug british-empire, 1757-1858, 41 shapes), which sa-06-c wrote as a dossier; eight sibling dossiers name british-empire as the counterpart of losses that east-india-company records as gains. The compile step must draw one of them for 1757-1858.

portuguese-india (1505-1961, South Asian possessions only) overlaps the Indian cells of portuguese-empire (1502-1823); the Goa-Daman-Diu shape of 1954-1961 resolves to about 4,050 km2 against the infobox 4,305 km2 (Dadra and Nagar Haveli included).

Vassal direction: the schema puts vassal_start and vassal_end in the SUZERAIN's dossier with the vassal as counterpart. Five dossiers of this batch first recorded them on the vassal's side (suzerain as counterpart); those events were removed and their text kept at the end of each dossier's notes. Suzerain-side records now exist for: east-india-company (kingdom-of-coorg 1790-1834, kingdom-of-tripura 1809-1858, koch-bihar 1773-1858, kingdom-of-manipur 1824-1858, bahawalpur-state 1833-1858); british-raj (kingdom-of-sikkim 1861-1947 and the paramountcy umbrella 1858-1947); durrani-empire (khanate-of-kalat 1758-1818). Still unrecorded: british-raj vassal pairs for khanate-of-kalat (Dec 1876 to Aug 1947), kingdom-of-manipur, kingdom-of-tripura, koch-bihar and bahawalpur-state (Nov 1858 to Aug 1947, covered only by the umbrella); islamic-republic-of-pakistan for bahawalpur-state (Oct 1947 to Oct 1955) and khanate-of-kalat (Mar 1948 to Oct 1955); republic-of-india for kingdom-of-sikkim (Dec 1950 to May 1975); mughal-empire for koch-bihar (1609) and the plains of kingdom-of-tripura (1733); the Dutch Ceylon and British suzerainty of maldives.

islamic-republic-of-pakistan records bahawalpur-state (Oct 1947) and khanate-of-kalat (Mar 1948) as direct gains, while this batch's dossiers keep both states alive to October 1955 (merger into West Pakistan on the Bahawalpur and Kalat pages); either Pakistan's gains become vassal pairs or the two states end in 1947 and 1948.
Several counterparts are not slugs of any dossier or Cliopatria row (see counterparts_needing_dossiers); the validator accepts them as free-text names.

WebFetch returns a small model's extract of each page, not the page: quotes in the notes are the extracts' words, and a detail an extract omits is recorded as 'page silent'. 'Conquest of Sindh' loaded the Arab conquest of Sindh article and was not used.
Page counts exceed the 2-5 per state guideline for east-india-company (31 pages, justified by the scope's year-by-year Company gains) and are within it for the others (2-5).
The grid is land-only at H3 resolution 5: maldives resolves to one cell and the southern atolls to none, so the Suvadive secession cannot be drawn.
